sampled.title: -4-社區支應老人在地老化之研究.pdf

terminus.finding: The paper explicitly defines community care as linking formal and informal resources and stresses familiar people, places and social networks as part of aging-in-place support. It is not a decisive empirical falsification, but it supplies a design counterpoint: formal systems can be intentionally built to connect rather than erase informal relational infrastructure.
terminus.quality: moderate conceptual utility; conventional argument, useful definitional and design evidence; not promoted as a major independent vein
terminus.next: seek empirical cases where such formal-informal integration demonstrably works in practice
